data.text: Welcome, Luke. My family’s fished here for years, and I want this lake to keep supporting the village. I’d favor an equal 10-ton share each this month—that’s $10,000 apiece while leaving enough fish to refill the lake. If someone wants less, we can agree beforehand to transfer part of their share, but let’s keep our combined catch at 50 tons. John, Kate, Emma—does that work for you?
